ops.old:
ntf has no server→phone *chat-message* push (verified 2026-10-10 from the
subcommand list: every subcommand except `light` reads phone data or manages
the plugin locally). On "push/notify my phone" requests, do not re-hunt for
a chat-push command; reach the phone through:

1. `ntf light` to the paired C·ONE hardware — verified 2026-10-13, and the
   standing reminder channel per AGENTS.md. See "Light pushes" below.
2. YoooClaw app chat — send the reminder as a chat message in the user's
   YoooClaw conversation; the app delivers its own push.
3. DingTalk via dws — see the dws-cli skill.
